description: Defines the base class QuicSpdyClientBase for a QUIC client that handles sending requests, managing sessions, and response handling within the quic namespace. It includes nested classes for response listening and data resending, and declares various methods and member variables related to QUIC and HTTP/2 communication.
external_methods: bool CheckVary(const spdy::Http2HeaderBlock&, const spdy::Http2HeaderBlock&, const spdy::Http2HeaderBlock&) override

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientBase
classes.description: Base class for a QUIC client handling HTTP/2 requests, responses, session management, and data resending within the quic namespace. It includes nested classes for response listening and data resending.

classes.name: ResponseListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that are notified when a complete response is received.

classes.name: QuicDataToResend
classes.description: Abstract class representing data that can be resent, such as HTTP requests that need to be retried after a connection issue.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with server ID, supported versions, config, helper interfaces, and session cache.

methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: SendRequest
